Context: 11. Letters of Appreciation

## 11. Letters of Appreciation  
1. Government policy in general discourages granting letter of apprecia tion or note of commendation to its employees and placing it in the APAR Dossier. Appreciation of work should more appropriately be recorded in APAR rather than in letters of appreciation which do not give complete perspective of the Government servant's good and bad points.
